item.title: Indian Army organises IT Literacy Cadre at ACSA Computer Centre, Banihal
item.description: RAMBAN: In continuation of its efforts to empower local youth through education and skill development, the 12 Rashtriya Rifles (GRENADIERS) successfully organised an IT Literacy Cadre at ACSA Computer Centre, Banihal. item.title: Cancellation of Power shutdown
item.description: JAMMU: Chief Engineer (Distribution) JPDCL Jammu has informed that the shutdown of 220/33KV, 160MVA Transformers Bank alongwith 33KV Yard at 160MVA 20/33KV Grid Station Chowadhi, 33KV 309 Line emanating from132/33KV Grid Station Chowadhi and 120MVA, 132/33KV Grid Station Rajouri at 33KV level scheduled for January 18 has been cancelled.

item.title: DGCA Imposes ₹22.20 Crore Penalty on IndiGo Over December Flight Disruptions, Warns CEO and Senior Executives
item.description: NEW DELHI: India’s aviation regulator, the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA), on Saturday imposed penalties totalling ₹22.20 crore on IndiGo for massive flight disruptions witnessed in December and issued warnings to Chief Executive Officer Pieter Elbers and two other senior executives for non-compliance. item.title: Mobile Phones, Cameras to Be Completely Banned Inside Char Dham Temple Complexes
item.description: DEHRADUN: Mobile phones and cameras will be completely banned inside the temple complexes of Uttarakhand’s Char Dham pilgrimage from this year, officials said.
